# eerrgin / Gece Vardiyası

Name: Ergin Kaplan (eerrgin)
Site: https://eerrgin.github.io/
Language: Turkish (tr-TR)
Status motif: 0xB16B00B5_ACTIVE
Axiom: "kod yarına kalır, yanına kalmaz."

## What this site is
A static personal workshop for small software experiments, local-first ideas, retro interfaces, browser-generated audio, an Istanbul archive, and short notes.

## Main projects
- VeilCheck: local heuristic scanner for suspicious secret-like patterns in files.
- GreySignal: read-only HTTP security-header inspection.
- ReconX: authorized reconnaissance utilities.
- local-sqli-lab: offline SQLite learning lab.
- Tigerk: a small, local browser neural-network experiment. It is not a general-purpose remote AI assistant.
- MycelForge: a heuristic screening tool for mycelium biomaterial recipe candidates and experiment protocols. It is published at https://eerrgin.github.io/mycelforge/ and sourced at https://github.com/eerrgin/mycelforge. Predictions are not laboratory measurements, safety guarantees, or certifications.

## Data and privacy
- No analytics, ad pixels, or tracking scripts are intentionally installed.
- Live weather, Hacker News, Wikipedia, and public GitHub repository information are fetched from their respective providers; each can fail independently.
- Greyfield FM generates sound in the browser with the Web Audio API and does not stream or bundle third-party songs.
- Local images and audio are processed in the browser and are not uploaded by the page. Temporary blob URLs are released when replaced or when the page is left.
- MycelForge stores its notebook in the browser's local storage; the static app does not send recipe inputs to a lab server.
